text: {"original_span": "The PGR advantage over the baseline exceeds two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the direction of the effect is supported rather than attributable to seed noise alone.", "new_span": "The PGR advantage over the baseline exceeds four standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the effect is statistically significant and cannot be attributed to seed noise.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "The 0.44 gap is about 4.4 SEs only if SE were smaller; with SE=0.1 the gap is ~4.4 SE but the claim of established significance ignores the missing baseline variability, overstating certainty."}
